description_en: Starts a suspended ApsaraDB RDS instance
description_zh: 该接口用于启动暂停的RDS实例
kebab_example: aliyun rds start-db-instance --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-instance-id rm-bp0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: StartDBInstance

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query the region ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: This operation also supports starting ApsaraDB RDS instances in a dedicated cluster. In this case, you must specify the dedicated cluster ID. You can call the DescribeDedicatedHostGroups operation to query the dedicated cluster ID
parameters.help_zh: 该接口也支持暂停专属集群下的RDS实例，此时需要配置专属集群ID。可调用DescribeDedicatedHostGroups查询
parameters.name: dedicated_host_group_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query the instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the destination host for the primary node. This parameter is only supported for instances in a dedicated cluster.

You must specify this parameter when DBInstanceTransType is set to 2
parameters.help_zh:
该参数仅支持专属集群实例，配置主节点的目标主机ID。

DBInstanceTransType=2时需要传该本参数
parameters.name: target_dedicated_host_id_for_master

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the destination host for the secondary node. This parameter is only supported for instances in a dedicated cluster.

You must specify this parameter when DBInstanceTransType is set to 2
parameters.help_zh:
该参数仅支持专属集群实例，配置备节点的目标主机ID。

DBInstanceTransType=2时需要传入该参数
parameters.name: target_dedicated_host_id_for_slave

parameters.help_en: [Deprecated] This parameter is deprecated and does not need to be specified
parameters.help_zh: 此参数已废弃，无需配置
parameters.name: target_dedicated_host_id_for_log

parameters.help_en:
The effective period. This parameter is only supported for instances in a dedicated cluster. Valid values:

Immediate: The changes take effect immediately.
MaintainTime: The changes take effect within the maintenance window. For more information, see ModifyDBInstanceMaintainTime.
SpecificTime: The changes take effect at a specified time.

Default value: MaintainTime
parameters.help_zh:
该参数仅支持专属集群实例，生效时间，取值：

Immediate：立即生效。
MaintainTime：在可运维时间段内生效，请参见ModifyDBInstanceMaintainTime。
SpecificTime：指定时间生效。

默认值：MaintainTime
parameters.name: effective_time

parameters.help_en:
The specified time when the changes take effect. This parameter is only supported for instances in a dedicated cluster. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

You must specify this parameter when EffectiveTime is set to Specified
parameters.help_zh:
该参数仅支持专属集群实例，指定切换的时间。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。

当EffectiveTime=Specified时需要填入本参数
parameters.name: specified_time

parameters.help_en: The instance type of the target instance. This parameter is only supported for instances in a dedicated cluster
parameters.help_zh: 该参数仅支持专属集群实例，目标实例的规格
parameters.name: target_db_instance_class

parameters.help_en: The database engine version. This parameter is only supported for instances in a dedicated cluster
parameters.help_zh: 该参数仅支持专属集群实例，数据库版本
parameters.name: engine_version

parameters.help_en:
The migration method of the instance. This parameter is only supported for instances in a dedicated cluster. Valid values:
0: Default value. The system preferentially performs a local upgrade or downgrade. If local resources are insufficient, the system performs a cross-instance migration.
1: Local upgrade or downgrade. If the system determines that the instance does not support local upgrade or downgrade, an error is returned.
2: Cross-instance migration. The instance is migrated to a specified host. You must specify the DedicatedHostGroupId, TargetDedicatedHostIdForMaster, and TargetDedicatedHostIdForSlave parameters. The instance cannot be migrated to the current host. Otherwise, the migration fails
parameters.help_zh:
该参数仅支持专属集群实例，实例的迁移方式。取值：
0：默认值。系统优先进行本地升降级，若本地资源不足，则进行跨机迁移。
1：本地升降级。若系统判断实例当前不支持本地升降级，则会报错。
2：跨机迁移。将实例迁移到指定的主机，需要传入参数DedicatedHostGroupId、TargetDedicatedHostIdForMaster、TargetDedicatedHostIdForSlave。不能迁移到当前实例所在主机，否则会迁移失败
parameters.name: db_instance_trans_type

parameters.help_en: The custom storage capacity. This parameter is only supported for instances in a dedicated cluster. Valid values: 5 to 2000. Unit: GB. If you do not specify this parameter, the storage capacity remains unchanged
parameters.help_zh: 该参数仅支持专属集群实例，自定义存储空间，取值：5~2000。单位：GB。不传该参数表示存储空间保持不变
parameters.name: storage

parameters.help_en: The vSwitch ID. This parameter is only supported for instances in a dedicated cluster
parameters.help_zh: 该参数仅支持专属集群实例，交换机ID
parameters.name: vswitch_id

parameters.help_en: The zone ID. This parameter is only supported for instances in a dedicated cluster
parameters.help_zh: 该参数仅支持专属集群实例，可用区ID
parameters.name: zone_id

MigrationId.description_en: The ID of the migration task. This parameter is only supported for instances in a dedicated cluster
MigrationId.description_zh: 该参数仅支持专属集群实例，迁移任务ID
